title: Mass of a current with constant m-vector against a Radon measure
statement: Let P, m ∈ ℕ, ν a Borel measure on ℝ^P finite on compact sets, ζ₀ ∈ Λ_m(ℝ^P) (a continuous linear functional on m-covectors, MultiVector P m) and s ∈ ℝ such that |ζ₀(α)| ≤ s·|α| for every m-covector α (|·| = covectorEuclideanNorm) and ζ₀(β) = s for some β with |β| ≤ 1 (so s is the dual norm of ζ₀). If Ξ ∈ 𝒟_m(ℝ^P) satisfies Ξ(ω) = ∫ζ₀(ω(x))dν(x) for every test m-form ω, then M_W(Ξ) = s·ν(W) (in [0, ∞], s read as ofReal s) for every open W ⊆ ℝ^P.
lean_statement: ∀ (P m : ℕ) (ν : Measure (Euclid P)) (ζ₀ : MultiVector P m) (s : ℝ) (Ξ : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) m), (∀ K : Set (Euclid P), IsCompact K → ν K < ∞) → (∀ α : Covector (Euclid P) m, |ζ₀ α| ≤ s * covectorEuclideanNorm α) → (∃ β : Covector (Euclid P) m, covectorEuclideanNorm β ≤ 1 ∧ ζ₀ β = s) → (∀ ω : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) m, Ξ ω = ∫ x, ζ₀ ((ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) m) x) ∂ν) → ∀ W : Set (Euclid P), IsOpen W → Ξ.massOn W = ENNReal.ofReal s * ν W
